title: Slice 440258: Fixed Asset Journal Approval
summary: Fixed Asset Journal entries can now be approved through the approval workflow system before posting.
key_points: Added approval workflow support to Fixed Asset Journal similar to other journal types
Journal batch and line tables extended with approval-related fields and logic
Approvals management codeunit updated to handle Fixed Asset Journal approval flow
Workflow setup and webhook management configured for Fixed Asset Journal approvals
Comprehensive test coverage added for Fixed Asset Journal approval workflows
quote: Auditors require all journal entries to be approved. Would be nice to have journal entry approval in Fixed Asset Journal.
